source:
@@U01820@@
God’s wrath seizes you!
The trumpet sounds!
The graves quake!
And your heart,
roused from its ashes to suffer
the tormenting flames,
leaps up in agony!

@@U01822@@
O God, to be out of here!
I feel the organ suffocating me,
the choir dissolving my soul to its very depths!

@@U01828@@
I'm stifling!
The columns closing around me!
The ceiling crashing down on me!
Air!

@@U01830@@
Hide yourself!
Sin and shame cannot stay hidden.
Air? Light?
Woe to you!

@@U01836@@
The Blest turn their
faces from you.
The Pure shudder
translation:
@@U01820@@
神的愤怒抓住了你！
号角吹响了！
坟墓震动！
还有你的心，
从灰烬中醒来受苦
折磨人的火焰，
痛苦地跳了起来！

@@U01822@@
上帝啊，离开这里吧！
我感觉这个器官让我窒息
合唱团深深地溶解了我的灵魂！

@@U01828@@
我闷死了！
柱子围住了我！
天花板轰然倒塌砸在我身上！
空气！

@@U01830@@
隐藏自己！
罪恶和羞耻是无法隐藏的。
空气？光？
你有祸了！

@@U01836@@
祝福者转动他们的
来自你的面孔。
纯粹的颤抖
